label: CRYPT3X OS LITE
note: 8 GiB GPT image is too large for an APK. Pick the .img or .img.zip from storage; the flasher stages CRYPT3X_OS_LITE/ and verifies SHA-256. Flash the raw image with dd (see tool/flash_crypt3x_lite.sh).

flash.dd: sudo dd if=lineage-18.1-20260815-1244-r36s-crypt3x-lite.img of=/dev/sdX bs=4M status=progress conv=fsync
